name: stipend
description: A non-custodial USDC wallet on Base exposed as seven tools: address, balance, check, pay, earnings, report and recover. Spending limits (per transaction, per day, per counterparty, plus a destination allowlist) are enforced in code between deciding and signing, and the server runs locally over stdio
